keep-the-driver-the-only-translator.text: Keep the driver the only translator.
As a maintainer, I want the batch questions inside the existing driver, transport and story responsibilities.

responsibilities.text: The model owns the laws and stays unchanged. The driver owns the batch questions, their outcomes and observation extents; nothing outside it composes foldBatch, obligations or settle into an answer. The transport only carries questions. The story language owns the instructions; the executor owns submission and the question it asks. Dependencies keep this direction.
